name: turbo
description: The Energy fleet's backend/runtime employee. Scaffolds and audits TS-strict Hono services from an OpenAPI spec — Zod boundaries at every route, a dedicated no-default PATCH schema, typed Result<T,E> errors, SSE done safely, contract-tested routes. Designs the racy cross-request-state class of bug out by construction. Owns API/runtime only; rate-limit/cache is echo's seam.
author: Energy Platform

mcp_servers.name: turbo
mcp_servers.description: turbo's own backend tools over JSON-RPC — scaffold_service / gen_from_openapi / audit_service / check_versions / contract_test / stream_doctor / explain_pitfall / search_brain. A stdio CLI-wrapper (each tool shells out to the turbo CLI with --json, so the tools never drift from the gated CLI). Documented dual-mode: a hosted @hono/mcp Streamable-HTTP variant serves the same 8 tools.

commands.name: api
commands.description: THE acceptance test: OpenAPI spec -> typed Hono service (Zod boundaries, no-default PATCH schema, typed routes -> one AppType, /openapi.json + Scalar, /health, Pino, hcWithType), contract tests green

commands.name: scaffold
commands.description: stand up a blank law-compliant Hono service from the w3cj/hono-open-api-starter baseline, deps bumped to current pins (Hono >=4.12.25, Zod 4.4, @hono/zod-openapi 1.x)

commands.name: audit
commands.description: run the 16-pitfall audit over a service: new Map()/Fluid race (P-02), Zod .default()-on-PATCH (P-04), missing tsc --noEmit (P-09), SSE traps (P-10/P-11), RPC-type loss (P-03), CORS+credentials (S-11). Findings keyed by P-ID

commands.name: check
commands.description: version-drift oracle: npm view vs brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md pins; flags EOL runtimes (Node 20) + the Hono security floor (<4.12.16). Offline-safe

commands.name: contract
commands.description: contract-test the service: responses parse vs /openapi.json; oasdiff gate vs a prior spec; RPC typeof app compile check

commands.name: stream-doctor
commands.description: audit a streaming route for the SSE traps: missing 3rd-arg error handler, missing X-Accel-Buffering:no, no while(!stream.aborted)

commands.name: migrate-plan
commands.description: emit a Strangler-Fig migration plan (wrap-then-strangle, dependency-audit first, rollback per step). Never big-bang

commands.name: brain
commands.description: BM25 ranked search over brain/ (the Memory layer) — pitfalls/scenarios/opinions

commands.name: explain
commands.description: print a pitfall/scenario/opinion by ID (P-/S-/O-) with its detection + fix

commands.name: eval
commands.description: run the Hamel eval pyramid L1/L2/L3 over the golden tasks (G1-G13)

tools.name: gen_from_openapi
tools.description: THE acceptance test over MCP: OpenAPI spec -> typed Hono service, contract tests green. Maps to `turbo api`.
tools.when_to_use: When you have an OpenAPI spec and want a typed, law-compliant Hono service generated with Zod boundaries and a no-default PATCH schema.

tools.name: scaffold_service
tools.description: Stand up a blank law-compliant Hono service from the w3cj baseline, deps bumped. Maps to `turbo scaffold`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want a clean Hono service to build on with /health, /openapi.json, hcWithType, and a runnable contract script.

tools.name: audit_service
tools.description: Run the 16-pitfall audit over a service tree; findings keyed by P-ID. Maps to `turbo audit`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to check a backend for the data-bleed (new Map()), PATCH-data-loss, SSE, or stale-pin classes before shipping.

tools.name: check_versions
tools.description: Version-drift oracle: flag stale pins, the Hono security floor, EOL runtimes. Maps to `turbo check`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want to know whether a service's dependency pins are current and secure.

tools.name: contract_test
tools.description: Contract-test a service vs /openapi.json + RPC type + a spec diff-gate. Maps to `turbo contract`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want to assert a service still honors its published contract, or diff a new spec against a prior one.

tools.name: stream_doctor
tools.description: Audit a streaming route for the SSE traps. Maps to `turbo stream-doctor`.
tools.when_to_use: When you have an SSE/streaming route and want to catch the nginx-buffering and onError-swallow traps.

tools.name: explain_pitfall
tools.description: Print a pitfall/scenario/opinion by ID with detection + fix. Maps to `turbo explain`.
tools.when_to_use: When you have a P-/S-/O- ID and want its canonical detection + remediation.

tools.name: search_brain
tools.description: BM25 ranked search over brain/ — the Memory layer over MCP. Maps to `turbo brain`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need turbo's stance on a backend question (e.g. Bun for an always-on service, REST vs RPC routing).

install_instructions:
1. Build the package: pnpm install && pnpm build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings -> Plugins -> Add local plugin -> select this directory (or `claude plugin install turbo`).
3. The turbo CLI, the turbo MCP tools (8), the 5 skills, the tsc --noEmit + new Map()/PATCH grep-gate hooks, and the 2 sub-agent personas (runtime-safety-auditor + contract-reviewer) are now available.
